verdict.rationale: Runpod is a hosted GPU cloud/SaaS platform; there is no evidence of a self-hostable core product (e.g., open-source server you can run on your own infrastructure). Only the CLI (runpodctl) is open source for managing the hosted service, and community evidence even notes the execution environment is 'locked down' and cloud-only, not self-hostable. Missing for 10: any open-source core platform/runtime release, self-hosting install instructions, or evidence of running Runpod's control plane outside Runpod's own cloud.
